nodes.note: Internal order-level branching is deliberately left unresolved in v1.
Several deeper relationships inside Afrotheria are left unresolved in v1.
Relationships among the major scrotiferan branches are shown as a polytomy in v1.
The deepest placental split remains debated; Xenarthra, Afrotheria and Boreoeutheria are therefore shown as a polytomy in v1.
